title: MariaDB JSON_CONTAINS fallback for grievance dashboard
summary: GrievanceJsonSql::memberOf() now uses JSON_CONTAINS on MariaDB and MySQL older than 8.0.17, fixing fatal SQL errors on GET /api/grievance/dashboard where MEMBER OF is unsupported.

items: supportsMemberOf() detects server version; memberOf() falls back to JSON_CONTAINS with CAST(id AS CHAR) on MariaDB (not CAST AS JSON)
Asserts correct SQL dialect and EXPLAIN succeeds on current server
